fallback_scan.note: All 6 vulnerabilities (5 high, 1 moderate) are in dev-only dependencies (picomatch, rollup) used by Vite/Vitest. Zero production vulnerabilities found.

sanitisation.detail: POST /api/feedback sanitises all free-text fields: HTML entities encoded (<, > → <, >), inputs capped at 10,000 chars before inclusion in GitHub Issue body

authentication.detail: POST /api/feedback uses requireAuth middleware — unauthenticated requests receive HTTP 401

input_validation.detail: express-validator validates type (enum), title (max 120), description (required); 400 returned on failure

rate_limit_handling.detail: GitHub 429 responses propagated to caller as HTTP 429 with retryAfter header

timeout_handling.detail: createIssue() wraps GitHub API call in 10s Promise.race timeout; GITHUB_TIMEOUT → HTTP 503

correlation_id.detail: All log statements in createIssue() and POST /api/feedback route include [correlationId] prefix

no_secrets_in_code.detail: No hardcoded credentials; repository config comes from config.github.selfServiceRepo (environment-driven)

sli_slo_mapping.sli: Free-text fields sanitised before issue creation
sli_slo_mapping.slo: 100% — no raw HTML in issue body
